purpose: DESNZ domestic energy volumes: Energy Trends domestic electricity (table 5.5) and gas (table 4.1) consumption at actual temperature, annual and quarterly, United Kingdom, 2022 to the latest quarter (the published level the LCFS kWh rake scales to, summed over the four quarters of calendar 2024; microcosm#1113), and the subnational electricity and gas statistics' domestic consumption and meter counts for Great Britain, England and Wales, the countries and the English regions, 2023 and 2024 (the published gas-connected share by region: gas meters over electricity meters; and the Great Britain totals that level the local-authority energy rows, microcosm#1207).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
